description: This file defines React components related to a Role Card UI element in a job/career exploration web application. It includes the main 'RoleCard' component, which displays detailed information about a role, including animations on hover, selection behavior, and responsive design elements, as well as a Skeleton component for loading states.

methods.name: RoleCard
methods.description: React functional component that renders an animated, interactive role card with hover and selection states.

methods.name: SkeletonCard
methods.description: React component rendering a placeholder skeleton for the RoleCard during loading states.
